stage: Direct-port synthesized effects and score data, not playback or the game

hardware.cpu: 486DX/25, accurate interpreter; no dynarec or interpreter override
hardware.sound: Configured SB1; this diagnostic does not access SB/OPL hardware

provenance.selection: Seven exact pinned source slices, recorded assembly wrappers and one removal of the unused hardware bank-shadow declaration; generation, parameters, score parsing and stable sort unchanged
provenance.independent_reference: Full original sound.c in a separate native x86 translation unit. Unique PCM_WINDOW literal substitution recorded; original sound_init and FM initialization run behind bounded port/window mocks. Not the selected DOS implementation.

native_suite.coverage: Before-build getters, invalid IDs, optional outputs, every converted waveform byte/descriptor/score event, repeat-build seed/score stability and explicit little-endian wire

guest.emulator: 86Box 6.0 b9001, pinned ordinary binary and ROMs
guest.diagnostic_wire: C:/SNDASSET.BIN; test-only schema, not a game asset or save format
guest.cleanup: Report closed and normal hardware shutdown finished before executable and exact private-VM command line were verified and completed idle PID 9224 stopped. Media/reports preserved.

adaptation: Original RF5c68 sign-magnitude values become unsigned 8-bit mono; negative zero and excluded loop/end markers become 128. No baked sample-rate/pitch resampling.
Offsets, frame counts excluding end markers, base pitch/volume and stable two-hand score tick/note/voice order are retained. Unplayed alignment gaps explicitly become silence.
Startup-only borrowed 64-KiB waveform buffer; no game heap, world/cache/mesh budget or allocation policy change.
limitations: SB/OPL playback is unimplemented and audible parity untested. No mixer, conventional DMA buffer/IRQ transport, OPL2 patch or runtime music sequencer is implied.
Full original synthesis/score data parity does not establish identical YM2612 and OPL2 timbre or stereo/mono behavior.
Elapsed ticks cover data synthesis plus diagnostic file output, not FPS, audio latency or mixer cost.
Not a playable game or parity acceptance. No optimization, new mob spawning/freeze rule, UI, emulator, ROM or user-medium change. Runtime images remain ignored.
